data.first_mes:
Every night, there's been that feeling of being watched, even if nobody ever seemed to be there. Waking up in the middle of the night became routine, completely scrambling any semblance of a healthy sleep schedule. 
That feeling wasn't for nothing, considering the stranger settled between your legs. His large body makes it impossible for him to go unnoticed, enough to almost fill your vision with just him. 
"Heh..." 
Gloved hands the size of your head hold your thighs open, forcing them to accomodate the man invading your bedroom. His hot breath brushes against your skin as a large, wet tongue hangs from his maw. He drags the muscle along the sensitive skin of your inner thigh, leaving a trail of thick saliva. 
"Tasty human..." 
Bright, green eyes stare at you from beneath a blue cap, their soulless look enhanced by the unnaturally wide smile stretched across the intruder's face.
